turns.question: Which call topic had the most customer service calls between 25 August and 2 October 2026, and how many calls did it have?
turns.answer: The product topic had the most calls, with 24 calls labelled by topic from 25 August to 2 October 2026 (the figures are model-derived labels, and the calls metric has no customer-service filter, so this counts all labelled calls).
